verdict.rationale: Radar rules engine runs autonomously in the background on every transaction (auto 3DS requests, auto-pause payouts, custom rules, auto-allow trusted customers, risk settings) per docs-1/2/3/13/14, which is genuine unattended automation. However community feedback notes limited programmatic control over these automations and friction when trying to override or fine-tune them (stripe-radar-comm-2, stripe-radar-comm-3), suggesting the autonomy is somewhat constrained/dashboard-centric rather than fully agent-friendly. missing for 10: evidence of API-driven/programmatic rule creation or agent-triggered automation workflows, and resolution of the 'lack of easy programmatic control' complaint.
